scientific_question: Does the average total reactive astrocyte area surrounding CA1 pyramidal neurons capture perineuronal glial-burden signal for memory decline better than the current separate cuff-count and single-cell hypertrophy summaries?
approach: For each slide, assign cells to CA1 using centroid-in-polygon region mapping from CustomAnnotations after dividing polygon coordinates by 16. Identify CA1 Pyramidal Neuron centroids and CA1 Reactive Astrocyte centroids from ClassificationNode labels. Compute each reactive astrocyte contour area from SegmentationNode/contours after centering contours before polygon-area calculation. For each CA1 pyramidal neuron, find all CA1 reactive astrocytes within radius r of the neuron centroid, sum their contour areas to get that neuron's local reactive-area burden, and assign 0 when no reactive astrocytes are nearby. The donor-level biomarker is the mean per-neuron reactive-area burden across all CA1 pyramidal neurons.

variations.name: mean_total_reactive_area_r35um
variations.description: Baseline: mean summed reactive astrocyte contour area within 35 um of each CA1 pyramidal neuron, averaged across all CA1 pyramidal neurons.

variations.name: mean_total_reactive_area_r45um
variations.description: Local radius sweep: same burden metric but using a 45 um neighborhood to test whether a slightly broader peripyramidal niche is more informative.

notes: Use the same micron-to-pixel conversion already used for prior r35um features; if needed derive it from the paired SVS MPP. Keep the computation centroid-based for neighborhoods. Reactive astrocytes can contribute area to multiple nearby neurons if they fall within multiple neighborhoods. Return 0 burden for neurons with no nearby reactive astrocytes. If a slide unexpectedly has no CA1 pyramidal neurons, return NaN gracefully. Ignore AppleDouble files.
rationale: Rounds 3-6 suggest that two pieces of the same CA1 niche matter independently: how many reactive astrocytes cuff pyramidal neurons and how enlarged those reactive astrocytes are. The cleanest next test is to combine these into one interpretable burden measure: total reactive astrocytic area in the peripyramidal neighborhood of each CA1 pyramidal neuron. This stays on the strongest lead, changes only the feature summary, and could either add new signal or replace one of the more redundant cuff-threshold members with a cleaner severity readout.
